name: Paradise Hotel Busan
verdict: Five-star Busan hotel and a Paradise Group affiliate; the group is controlled by chairman Philip Jeon through holding company Paradise Global (67.3%). Nothing found.
note: Named one of Korean Golf Club's three new corporate team sponsors for 2026 by LIV Golf (May 2026). Quick company check (2026-10-03): no court, regulator, UN or major-NGO human-rights finding against Paradise Hotel Busan or Paradise Group found.
